details: Zenodo 3713449 holds one 9.8 GB archive (ULF_in_ADL.zip) of full-body inertial-sensor .mvnx XML files, one per trial, for 30 daily-living tasks (gestures, grasping, tool use), which are not target reaches with a hand direction per trial; the whole archive is over the 5 GB limit. CC BY 4.0; the record cites no paper (NCT03135093, SoftPro grant 688857).
